findings.finding: Custom native ZIP format cannot hold professional large Studio projects unchanged: writer refuses more than 65,535 entries and archive/entry offsets above 4 GiB; save_zip holds complete Vec output.
findings.disposition: Replace container layer with bounded streaming ZIP64 or approved equivalent; retain CAS/manifest algorithm concepts.
findings.counterfactual: A 300,000px image can have sparse tile counts beyond the archive entry cap even if individual objects are small; timeline originals can individually exceed 4 GiB. A small-file roundtrip cannot prove this boundary.

findings.finding: Ordinary import/render corpus can reuse Photoshop smart/text cached pixels. Source's rerender acceptance floor is only 5 matching files from 86 smart/type targets, and font-dependent matches are excluded from the floor.
findings.disposition: Separate visual cached-preview parity, graph/editable semantics and post-edit engine rerender proof. Acquire Photoshop-authored oracle fixtures with exact fonts/profile/assets and rerender after edits.
findings.counterfactual: Open an apparently matching PSD then change the text or embedded smart object: cached pixels cease to protect the missing engine behavior.

findings.finding: GPU tests return early on missing adapter, missing Rgba32Float support or pipeline construction error.
findings.disposition: Declared Handshake proof lane must record adapter/backend and require the oracle; unavailable hardware is NO_PROOF, never green GPU acceptance. CPU and device-loss paths require separate evidence.

findings.finding: PSD import knowingly changes unsupported/corrupt semantics: undecodable channels become empty with warning, unknown blend uses Normal, selected modes flatten or convert depth; export can rasterize text/smart layers or omit unwritten adjustments.
findings.disposition: Adapt warnings into typed loss reports with object, source semantics, proposed replacement and acceptance policy; preserve original bytes and reject unapproved semantic loss. Current strings are useful diagnostics, not full fidelity contract.

findings.finding: PhotoCraft central engine alone owns 148 src files/74,172 physical lines and depends on almost every raster/domain/interchange/plugin leaf; UI owns 189 src files/94,581 lines and pulls GPU, engines, IO and codecs. Workspace default-members also includes all crates and xtask.
findings.disposition: Fork selected leaf algorithms and typed adapters, not the broad engine/UI facade. Use explicit package/feature command closures and measured Cargo timings when implementation is authorized; modularity alone is not a measured compilation speedup.

findings.finding: Windows WIA command advertises available:true while returning empty devices because enumeration/transfer is not wired; test asserts only array/OS availability.
findings.disposition: Keep scanner/tether/acquisition workflow in parity scope but treat upstream implementation as stub. Capability registry must distinguish absent implementation from detected zero devices.

findings.finding: RAW recognition includes CR3 and RAF, but raw::decode explicitly rejects both. Format visibility/recognition does not prove development support.
findings.disposition: Map decoder/developer/camera-profile coverage to the shared Studio RAW owner audited in LightCraft lane; do not duplicate raw pipelines or label all extensions supported.

findings.finding: Upstream's actual GPU consumer exists despite stale future-work header; high-bit texture display can downgrade to RGBA8 beyond F16 pixel budget. Source search must include real consumers and display provenance.
findings.disposition: Argus snapshots should carry display precision/profile/proxy/backend and document revision, so an 8-bit display approximation is not interpreted as export-quality proof.

findings.finding: Session active document/selection is shared, authorization hook is optional, and worker conflict protection is whole-document pointer identity rather than mergeable object revisions.
findings.disposition: Reuse detached worker computations but translate into Handshake actor-scoped views, explicit targets, object revisions/leases and typed receipts. Native trusted-local bypass must not become model ToolGate bypass.

findings.finding: Native format has real hash/size/depth controls and separate serialized model, but only version 1 exists and production migration steps are empty.
findings.disposition: Reuse design pattern after review; do not claim field-proven multiversion migration from synthetic step tests. Unknown-field/extension preservation needs a separate explicit Studio contract.

findings.finding: Own workspace forbids unsafe generally, while tablet/macOS isolates three explicit Objective-C unsafe calls. This does not establish unsafe-free transitive dependency graph or Windows/ARM input behavior.
findings.disposition: Adopt engine leaves independent from macOS shell/tablet bridge; audit all transitive native dependencies and real Windows x64/ARM input lanes before claiming portability.

findings.finding: Command registry silently preserves first matching duplicated id rather than rejecting duplicates; parameters are mostly descriptive JSON strings.
findings.disposition: Handshake canonical capability owner must validate globally unique semantic ids and typed ParamSpec once. Adapt commands into that registry and generate shared GUI/manual/Argus exposure from the same schema.

findings.finding: Package/runtime authority and build subset are not equivalent to the entire 711-package lock graph. Static lock inventory includes duplicated external package versions and target/dev dependencies; no Cargo graph or timings were executed.
findings.disposition: When activated, resolve exact selected package/feature/target closures and enforce dependency-budget/canonical version ownership before claiming isolation or speedup.

reuse_boundaries.boundary: Own standalone dependency leaf (thiserror/flate2; optional serde) parsing/writing PSD/PSB/presets and preserving opaque tagged/resources structure; no PhotoCraft engine/UI required.
reuse_boundaries.adaptation: Use through isolated byte parser/writer adapter. Enforce input/output budgets, preserve originals, convert into canonical StudioDocument with typed loss receipts. PSD editable renderer remains separate.

reuse_boundaries.boundary: cms has no declared dependencies; ICC profile/curve/CLUT/pipeline/transform/LUT modules. color adds serde and cms, owns pixel format/blend/conversion.
reuse_boundaries.adaptation: Compare pure-Rust CMS candidate against shared color owner from other drills; select one canonical ICC/OCIO/display pipeline. Independent ICC test corpus, intent/blackpoint/CMYK/spot/HDR and certified print workflows required.

reuse_boundaries.boundary: Sparse COW storage and StrokeRenderer depend on geometry/color/raster, not GPU/GUI/IO/DB. Every root module/dependency is enumerated in crate_inventory.
reuse_boundaries.adaptation: Translate coordinates/units/ids into Studio contracts, retain deterministic brush seeds/selection/lock/damage; one raster owner serving RAW masks, vector rasterization and compositing without near-duplicate stores.

reuse_boundaries.adaptation: Adapt data views around canonical StudioDocument; select shared color/text/geometry owners, maintain backend-independent CPU result and explicit GPU unsupported fallbacks. Do not merge upstream entire domain model as second state authority.

reuse_boundaries.boundary: Versioned manifest, CAS zstd object store, hash verification, finite checks, snapshot autosave and atomic writes are actual implementation.
reuse_boundaries.adaptation: Reuse mechanisms as source pattern, replace archive size/entry/memory constraints, integrate live SurrealDB/EventLedger snapshot/provenance and durable crash proof. User-requested new native format is broader than raster .pcraft.

reuse_boundaries.boundary: Pure-Rust wasmi host with no imports, per-run store, ABI/manifest checking, instruction/memory/time limits and banded pixel application.
reuse_boundaries.adaptation: Bind approved plugin capabilities to Handshake ToolGate/security/diagnostics and shared document transactions; don't create another registry/daemon.

reuse_boundaries.boundary: Enumerated complete crate roots and manifests; selected actual RAW decode dispatch and PSD text export read. Full camera demosaic, font shaping, vector raster and Affinity container algorithms not exhaustively read in this drill.
reuse_boundaries.adaptation: Deduplicate canonical RAW, font, vector, media codec and interchange owners across all Craft candidates; preserve domain semantics via adapters and differential fixtures.

reuse_boundaries.boundary: Reject wholesale adoption as a Handshake product architecture. They create separate app/session/history/control authority and couple .36 GUI with domain engines.
reuse_boundaries.adaptation: Read interaction/tool organization for useful behavior; implement single Handshake desktop shell through its reusable assets, Argus protocol and manual. CLI/headless concepts can guide an isolated asset harness without creating another shipped control server.
